guidance.claim: CaratLane will inch towards a low double-digit EBIT margin with scale.
guidance.quote: So I expect that overall margin, we had -- if you remember, a couple of quarters back, we had said that, gradually, CaratLane with the scale will start inching towards double -digit EBIT margin.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

guidance.claim: We will continue to deliver volume growth around 8% to 10%.
guidance.quote: This is what we have estimated, around an 8% to 10% growth. So this is what we will continue to deliver.
guidance.speaker: Devanshu Bansal

guidance.claim: Gold prices might continue to go up, creating margin stress.
guidance.quote: So one can expect that gold prices might continue to go up. And in that environment, there will be stress on margins.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

guidance.claim: Good revenue growth will help maintain EBIT or PBT level margins.
guidance.quote: As long as we are able to deliver good revenue growth, we will get operating leverage and we will able to maintain EBIT level or PBT level margin profile.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

reported.claim: We completed a 67% stake acquisition of Damas.
reported.quote: We are very happy to announce that we completed 67% stake acquisition of Damas.
reported.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

reported.claim: Consolidated exceptional item impact is INR152 crores, and INR138 crores standalone.
reported.quote: The impact on a consolidated level is INR152 crores, which has been shown an exceptional item in the consolidated as well as INR138 crores in stand-alone financials.
reported.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

reported.claim: Comparable standalone gross margin dipped by about 200 basis points in Q3.
reported.quote: The comparable gross margin, so that we report in our stand -alone financials, has dipped by about 200 basis points in Q3.
reported.speaker: Devanshu Bansal

reported.claim: The reported omnichannel revenue growth is 11% with close to 8% volume growth.
reported.quote: So the omnichannel sale, what we have reported, is 11%. That's the revenue growth. And this revenue growth has been reported by a volume growth of close to around 8%.
reported.speaker: Devanshu Bansal
